error[VIBE2906]: `v-memo` is not supported.
  --> template/unsupported/input.vibe:2:8
2 |   <div v-memo="[text]"></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Remove `v-memo`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2906

error[VIBE2907]: `v-once` is not supported.
  --> template/unsupported/input.vibe:3:8
3 |   <div v-once></div>
  |        ^^^^^^
fix: Remove `v-once`.
fix: Read the value once in `<script setup lang="ts">` and render that constant.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2907

error[VIBE2908]: `v-focus` is not a built-in directive, and custom directives are not supported.
  --> template/unsupported/input.vibe:4:8
4 |   <div v-focus></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^
fix: Reach the element with `useTemplateRef` and run the code in `onMounted` or a `watch`.
fix: Move reusable element logic into a composable that takes the template ref.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2908

error[VIBE2909]: `v-cloak` is not supported.
  --> template/unsupported/input.vibe:5:8
5 |   <div v-cloak></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^
fix: Remove `v-cloak`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2909

error[VIBE2910]: `@vue:mounted` is an element lifecycle listener, and lifecycle listeners are not supported.
  --> template/unsupported/input.vibe:6:8
6 |   <div @vue:mounted="count++"></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Use `onMounted` or `onUnmounted` with a template ref in `<script setup lang="ts">`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2910

error[VIBE2910]: `@vnode-mounted` is an element lifecycle listener, and lifecycle listeners are not supported.
  --> template/unsupported/input.vibe:7:8
7 |   <div @vnode-mounted="count++"></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Use `onMounted` or `onUnmounted` with a template ref in `<script setup lang="ts">`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2910
